{{Quote|NOT EVEN LIGHT ESCAPES THE HOLE|Cantina slogan|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
The '''Black Hole''', also known simply as '''The Hole''', was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Farpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fhost]] near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] of Farpoint was built upon the wreck of a crashed [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and the Black Hole was located in the remains of the former bridgetower. It was partially built from storage containers, and contained mismatched furniture that accumulated over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of ownership.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
In [[41 ABY]], the cantina was owned by [[Milsin]], who often tried new gimmicks he picked up from watching [[Hologram/Legends|holos]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], which, like all [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] shows and sport events on Fhost, were at least four [[Standard month|months]] old. In that year, a [[Brawl in the Black Hole|deadly brawl]] broke out in the Black Hole, after [[Khedryn Faal]] won the final hand with the help of [[Jaden Korr]] in a high-stakes game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
